children: Polar Power executed two financing moves to bolster liquidity and manage near-term obligations. On Aug 28, 2026, the company issued two convertible promissory notes totaling $165,000 in principal for $150,000 in proceeds to LU2 Holdings and CL Investment Group, bearing 1% monthly interest and maturing Nov 26, 2026, with unpaid amounts convertible at the lower of 80% of five-day VWAP or $1.00 per share. Separately, on Jul 27, 2026, Polar Power entered a Common Stock Purchase Agreement with Roth Principal Investments and committed to direct all net proceeds from stock sales under that agreement to repay the notes until fully satisfied. The moves aim to enhance liquidity while establishing a structured path to reduce short-term debt.
